title: A personal note from Eugine
body:
Thank you for installing OpenCode Desktop. I built this because I wanted a tool that made AI-powered coding feel natural — not like fighting a terminal. Whether you're a developer or just starting out, I hope this saves you real time every day.

This is where I'll send you updates, tips, and new feature announcements. You can always send me feedback directly from this panel.

— Eugine Micah
